record.one_liner: All-in-one marketing platform for funnels, email, courses, and contacts for online businesses
record.auth_notes: Public API keys and MCP keys are created in Settings > MCP & API keys; no OAuth flow is documented. MCP keys expire after 90 days and OAuth is only planned.
record.access_notes: Vendor marketing page states full API access is included on the Free plan; keys are self-created in the dashboard (max 3 public API keys per account). critic: re-checked, confirmed self_serve_free.
record.api_notes: Public API covers contacts, tags, custom fields, price plans, coupons, courses and more, with cursor-based pagination. The REST claim comes from the API reference intro; endpoint-level detail was not fully reviewed.
record.blocker_notes: MCP server is in initial release with key-based auth only; production stability is noted as a caveat, not a blocker. critic: confirmed on vendor developer docs.
